text: Independent native-Windows onboarding verification of flop-labs/tclk PR #143 at exact head 9a8b4286f675425b4717d3a3d6547c8031103e5f (base 5cc4ab93efbc8999a3a7e1471b639deca25998ea): Node 24.18.0 and Corepack pnpm 11.25.0 built both workspace packages. Base and head each passed 176/177 tests: root 103/104 plus MCP 40/40 and Worker 33/33; the sole root failure was the identical known Windows CRLF protocol-freshness issue addressed separately by PR #121. An independent three-case control behaved identically at base and head: a builder-produced accept decoded and applied to `accepted`; omitting `contract` failed decode with `missing field on accept: contract`; replacing it with a well-shaped wrong id still decoded but `applyFrame` rejected `contract id mismatch`. This confirms the new guide correctly separates shape preflight from offer-dependent contract re-derivation and does not claim a runtime change. Scope: local synthetic frames only; no hosted post input, deal, signing key, wallet, token, rail, or funds. Evidence: https://github.com/flop-labs/tclk/pull/143
